name: Woodland caravan camp
description: Empty woodland clearing at dusk, warm lantern light and subdued blue hills; three independently composed layers.
reuseWhen: Reuse the three matching layers together for woodland caravan evenings; keep the shared horizon, warm left light and overscan.

assets.description: Opaque dusk sky, distant trees/hills and reconstructed empty ground.
Transparent covered wagons at the sides with a small hanging lantern.
Transparent corner grasses, brambles and overhanging twigs.
Night variant: indigo sky, dim wooded clearing and amber illumination at an overnight rest stop; opaque far layer.
Night variant: twelve distinct covered wagons parked in one long receding line, with amber lanterns; transparent middle layer.
Night variant: dark corner foliage with amber-lit leaf edges; transparent near layer.
Transparent night midground with a long line of parked merchant wagons, paired draft teams, varied cargo, lanterns, and small groups of merchants and guards.

name: Tangled woodland road
description: Ochre road under a dense moss-and-blue canopy; transparent side trunks and fine near webbing.
reuseWhen: Reuse for subdued woodland ambushes; match perspective and road direction. Webs are visual dressing, not proof of an encounter.

assets.description: Opaque distant canopy and continuous empty dirt road.
Transparent gnarled trunks, roots and upper branches.
Transparent corner thorns, roots and sparse silk strands.

name: Three-Dragon Ante gathering
description: Grouped game crate, cards, Samardag/Radecere with indistinct faces, and watchful Sulesdeg/Tyjit. Cannot separate individual figures from this bitmap.
reuseWhen: Reuse only when these four people gather at the same game. Traveller appearances are provisional; no claim of approved individual portraits.

assets.description: Seated card players with coin pouches; two guards stand watching and do not play.
Selected card-game group with the dwarf guard’s stern face clearly rendered; travellers remain indistinct.
Night rest-stop game: five seated gamblers—Samardag, Balerias, Lucien beside Arietta, and Radecere—around the same lantern-lit crate table. Shared composition.

name: Arietta and Lucien walking
description: Arietta holds Lucien’s forearm; grouped walking pose preserves their interaction.
reuseWhen: Reuse for the pair walking calmly toward screen left. Lucien has cropped hair and trimmed beard; Arietta has olive cloak and blue-gray scarf.

assets.description: Full-body paired walking cutout; no spell effect or extra props.

name: Balerias Chukk
description: Elderly rugged ranger, long gray hair/beard, brass mechanical eye, worn moss-brown gear and oversized crossbow on his back.
reuseWhen: Reuse for calm feeding/offering actions with these clothes and equipment. Both poses share one frame and foot anchor.

assets.description: Patient crouched stance, food held near his chest.
Same frame with right arm extended toward screen right to offer food.

name: Oyn Evenmor
description: Broad graying wagon master with salt-and-pepper beard, cream tunic, green shawl, red sash, staff and small bird-cage rack.
reuseWhen: Reuse for Oyn watching cautiously at a safe distance; bird species remain unspecified.

assets.description: Full-body cautious watcher facing right with staff and small caged birds.

name: Lucien
description: Dark-skinned sorcerer with cropped black hair, short trimmed beard, crimson-purple robes and gold details.
reuseWhen: Reuse for a spell-assisted hurling action toward screen right. Attached stone/swirl is visual shorthand, not confirmation of a particular named spell.

assets.description: Full-body rightward casting/hurling pose with small loose stone and restrained ink swirl.
Monochrome crouched Lucien, intended for low opacity to suggest invisibility while writing.
Blue monochrome crouching Lucien with an icy edge. Pair with the invisibility treatment for a low-opacity body and stronger rim.
Lucien kneeling on one knee with a knife extended toward the cocoon.

name: Captive peryton
description: Provisional standard antlered feathered predator interpretation, folded wings, taloned legs and tiny amber eye reflection.
reuseWhen: Reuse as this provisional peryton when cautious and calm, facing left. Do not treat the eye glimmer as explained magic.

assets.description: Full-body wary peryton lowering its head toward an offering.

name: Travelling animal cage
description: Matched rear assembly and front gate planes for correct cage/animal depth ordering.
reuseWhen: Reuse rear at depth 35 and front at 45, placing the animal between them. Keep matching scale, frame, anchor and perspective.

assets.description: Empty roof/floor, rear bars and side posts, open front plane.
Front corner posts, thin iron bars and gate rim only; interior gaps transparent.

name: Horse wrapped in silk
description: Unnamed caravan horse grouped with harness, body webbing and silk tether; monochrome sepia avoids declaring a canonical coat.
reuseWhen: Reuse for an unnamed living horse under restraint, facing right. Do not identify it as Strawberry Three or Mo Two without source support.

assets.description: Full-body braced horse and silk tether, no visible injury.

name: Horse-dragging ettercap
description: One long-limbed coarse-haired spiderlike humanoid with mandibles; dragging and non-graphic defeated poses.
reuseWhen: Reuse as one continuous creature instance; a pose swap is not a second enemy. Keep existing encounter counts and do not resurrect defeated individuals.

assets.description: Braced left-facing creature pulling a silk tether.
Same creature collapsed with slack limbs and dropped silk; no gore.

name: Caravan horses fighting back
description: Two unnamed sepia caravan horses counterattack one spider; tightly grouped secondary battle beat.
reuseWhen: Reuse as the supporting horse/spider beat in this encounter; unnamed horses do not establish coats or assign a precise named target. Do not clone the group into extra enemies.

assets.description: One horse kicks a recoiling spider while a second raises a forehoof; non-graphic midground cutout.

name: Sulesdeg and Tyjit on watch
description: Shared guard compositions; the guards watch without joining the card game.
reuseWhen: Reuse for these two stationary guards at a nighttime camp, preserving their height difference and firelit/indigo lighting.

assets.description: Night variants of Sulesdeg with upright spear and Tyjit with folded arms, standing watch; neither plays cards.

name: Covered sleeping wagon
description: Three night layers for a covered wagon interior. The middle composition includes Arietta and Zelina asleep.
reuseWhen: Use the far shell and near cloth with matching light and perspective. The middle includes specific sleepers and needs the authored vertical alignment.

assets.description: Opaque wagon shell, canvas hoops, moonlit opening and bare floor.
Transparent middle layer with sleeping Arietta and Zelina, bedding and a lantern on a crate.
Transparent close blanket and canvas corners.

name: Journal, satchel and healing potion
description: Open journal and corked red healing potion in the sisters’ travel satchel.
reuseWhen: Shared prop arrangement with the journal open and its right page ready for a separate writing cue.

assets.description: Lantern-lit open journal and red healing potion on a leather travel satchel.

name: Emerald Pen
description: Faceted green pen with gold fittings and a fine nib.
reuseWhen: Position the nib anchor on the writing surface.

assets.description: Isolated Emerald Pen angled upward to the right, anchored at the nib.

name: Daylight road and secluded trail
description: Morning woodland road and separate trail with shared roadside overlays.
reuseWhen: Use the open road for passing wagons and the enclosed trail for a private walk.

assets.description: Opaque morning road and distant woodland hills.
Transparent roadside shrubs and rocks.
Transparent near grass and branches.
Opaque secluded daytime woodland footpath.

name: Cult wagon and draft team
description: Closed canvas wagon drawn by two draft horses.
reuseWhen: Use a separate driver and guard formation around the wagon.

assets.description: Closed wagon and two harnessed horses travelling in daylight.

name: Cult wagon guards
description: Stern escort and seated guard who drives the wagon.
reuseWhen: Use as background guard instances; keep weapons stowed or lowered for uneventful travel.

assets.description: Stern travelling spear guard, full-body standing cutout.
Seated Cult guard holding the wagon reins.

name: Aldrik and Balerias walking
description: Aldrik and Balerias confer privately as they walk side by side.
reuseWhen: Use for a private daylight conversation with their weapons stowed.

assets.description: Full-body pair walking and speaking quietly.

name: Aldrik Gauls’Thein
description: Aldrik Gauls’Thein — canonical party character record.
reuseWhen: Consult the appearance, equipment and events in this record before reusing any image.

assets.description: Mounted Aldrik glances back during a cautious daylight pass, crossbow stowed.
Mounted Aldrik hangs off the saddle and aims his light crossbow left beneath the horse’s neck.

name: Forest caravan wagon teams
description: Horse-drawn wagon teams with two conductors each.
reuseWhen: Use the ordinary teams for the convoy and place the Lucien and Coppercoil team second when recreating this beat.

assets.description: Covered merchant wagon with two draft horses and two drivers, approaching in three-quarter view.
Second wagon with Lucien and Coppercoil on its bench and two harnessed horses.
Lead wagon with Lucien and Coppercoil fighting from the bench. The ettercap attacks the left of its two harnessed horses.

name: Ettercap attacking a draft horse
description: A live ettercap lunges from the left at a harnessed horse.
reuseWhen: Use for the opening ambush. The attack and its victim share a single staged composition.

assets.description: Ettercap lunging at a frightened harnessed horse from screen left.

name: Light crossbow bolt
description: Left-facing wooden crossbow bolt.
reuseWhen: Align the projectile to the crossbow and hide it outside the brief firing cue.

assets.description: Horizontal bolt with metal head pointing left.

name: Spiders and caravan guards
description: Two giant spiders meet guards with spears and shield in a background skirmish.
reuseWhen: Use as a shared composition in the daylight forest ambush.

assets.description: Two giant spiders and three guards defending the caravan with spears and shield.

name: Coppergoat
description: Coppercoil’s small mechanical copper goat construct.
reuseWhen: Use this left-facing charging pose when Coppergoat rushes a target.

assets.description: Copper-plated mechanical goat charging left with horns lowered and faint summoning sparks.

name: Root-tangled woodland interior
description: Dense woodland beyond the road with uneven ground, exposed roots and shaded undergrowth.
reuseWhen: Use these three layers together for action deep in the shaded forest, away from the road.

assets.description: Opaque deep forest interior with dense trunks, rock shelves and sloping ground.
Transparent midground roots, ferns and rough mossy stone.
Transparent close root, fern and branch silhouettes framing the woodland floor.

name: Forest cocoon and recovered items
description: Two aligned states of the forest cocoon. The opened composition includes the woman, her scroll, a silver cloak pin and the gold.
reuseWhen: Use the aligned frames together for a closed-to-open pose change. The gold pile represents seventy-six pieces.

assets.description: Closed silk cocoon on its side, contents concealed.
Opened cocoon revealing a dead woman clutching a sealed scroll, a silver cloak pin and a pile of gold.

name: Aldrik, Balerias and Coppercoil at the cocoon
description: Three party members look down at the opened cocoon.
reuseWhen: Reuse for the same three characters observing something below them.

assets.description: Standing group of Aldrik, Balerias and Coppercoil looking down.
